Legendary Pals Guide

The six legendary Pals are the rarest and strongest in the game. Here's everything you need to know: elements, stats, breeding power and capture tips.

PalElementHPATKDEFBreeding power
Paladius Neutral 130 120 145 80
Necromus Dark 130 145 120 70
Frostallion Ice 140 140 120 120
Frostallion Noct Dark 140 140 135 100
Jetragon Dragon 110 140 110 90
Neptilius Water 105 145 125 90

Where to find them

  • Paladius & Necromus — the twin legendary riders, found in the desert area.
  • Frostallion — legendary ice steed, in the snowy Astral Mountains region.
  • Frostallion Noct — dark variant, obtainable through breeding or the alpha spawn.
  • Jetragon — the fastest flying mount in the game, near the volcanic region.
  • Neptilius — legendary water Pal, in the ocean areas of the later regions.

Tips: bring Legendary Spheres or higher, weaken them first, and save before the fight. They have very low catch rates.

Breeding the legendaries

Legendary Pals have very low breeding power, which makes them the result of many special combinations — check the Special Breeding Combos table to see which pairs produce them, and use the Breeding Calculator to verify any pair.
